# FSR 1

AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0, from
[GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR](https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR) at commit
`a21ffb8f6c13233ba336352bdff293894c706575` (`ffx-fsr/ffx_a.h`, `ffx-fsr/ffx_fsr1.h`, `license.txt`),
MIT license. Not compiled: the reference that `FX_EASU` / `FX_RCAS` in `runtime/portable/gfx_vulkan.c`
and `fx_easu` / `fx_rcas` in `runtime/portable/gfx_hlsl.c` are ported from (the 32-bit float paths).
